product: A SaaS starter that a developer forks to build their own SaaS. It runs on Cloudflare Workers with React Router v7, tRPC, D1 with Drizzle, Better Auth, Effect TS and ShadCN/Tailwind. It ships email and password auth, an admin dashboard (user list, ban and unban), file upload to R2, analytics, i18n (en, zh) and dark mode. Two kinds of people use it: the developer who forks it and extends it, and the end users of the SaaS that developer builds, who sign up, use the dashboard and upload files; admins manage users.

features.summary: Email and password sign-up and login with Better Auth; roles user and admin; banned users cannot sign in.
Admin-only area at /admin with a users table, ban and unban actions, and an analytics overview.
Signed-in users upload files to R2 through /api/upload-file; the bucket repository stores and lists them.
Event tracking through app/repositories/analytics.ts and the analytics tRPC router; admin overview reads it.
Locale files in app/locales (en, zh); the locale is set through /api/set-locale.
Light and dark themes through tokens in app/app.css.
Harness workflow that gives a fork its own brand.
Harness workflow that ships a plan as stacked PRs.

decisions.text: Effect TS is the default; no throw and no try/catch outside Effect.tryPromise.
Validation uses Effect Schema only; Zod is not allowed.
Failures are tagged errors in app/models/errors/, mapped in tagToTRPC in app/lib/effect-trpc.ts.
Every helper and repository ships with a unit test in the same diff.
Runtime is Cloudflare Workers, not Node; bindings come through the CloudflareEnv Tag or context.cloudflare.env, never process.env.
Changes to tables or user-visible data extend the fixtures in scripts/seed-preview.ts.
The workflow plans and audits tickets; it never writes application code.
Uploads go to R2 through app/repositories/bucket.ts; there is no other file store.
Admin actions live in app/trpc/routes/admin.ts and are limited to the admin role.
User-facing strings live in app/locales/{en,zh}; new copy needs both.
